name: meetlite-backend
description: Backend services for MeetLite video meeting application

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:room" "npm run dev:mediasoup"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:room" "npm run dev:mediasoup"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/shared && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/api-gateway && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/auth-service && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/room-service && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/mediasoup-service && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/edge-room-coordinator
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/api-gateway && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/auth-service && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/room-service && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/mediasoup-service && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/edge-room-coordinator
